ProductShot.definition: Product or creator-led footage: features, fit, setup, human operation, cleaning, removal, storage, testimonial, alternate non-dog use cases, or performance proof. Testimonial remains ProductShot when the creator testimonial is dominant and no dog is actively using/occupying CozyRider.

ProductUse.definition: Dog-led footage where the dog is actively using or experiencing CozyRider as the primary beat, including direct owner-dog interactions. Testimonial is also allowed when the testimonial is dominant while a dog is actively using/occupying CozyRider.

Problem.definition: Problem-led footage: pain point, failed alternative, failure state, or deliberate before/after problem comparison.

category_decision_order: Problem if pain/failure/failed alternative/before-after problem is the primary beat
ProductUse if dog actively uses or experiences CozyRider as the primary beat, or if Testimonial is dominant while a dog is actively using/occupying CozyRider

scene_definitions.FullProduct: General product-focused footage where the CozyRider as a whole is the primary subject and no more specific approved Scene is the main editor search intent.
scene_definitions.StoragePockets: Storage-pocket feature footage, including static display, opening, loading, unloading, or showing capacity.
scene_definitions.HardBottomPlatform: The rigid hard-bottom platform itself is the primary product feature being shown.
scene_definitions.WeightCapacityTest: A deliberate load-bearing or structural-support demonstration using weight, people, dogs, or another substantial load.
scene_definitions.DoorProtectors: Door-protector panels or coverage are the primary feature, including showing, attaching, positioning, securing, or adjusting the door protectors.
scene_definitions.MeshWindow: Mesh-window feature footage, including static display and human opening, closing, zipping, or unzipping.
scene_definitions.MetalClips: PawpyStuff metal clip hardware is the primary product detail.
scene_definitions.SeatAnchors: Seat-anchor feature footage, including showing, inserting, or operating the anchors.
scene_definitions.SeatbeltAccess: Seatbelt buckle openings, access, or threading through the cover are the primary feature/action.
scene_definitions.SeatbeltTether: The included safety tether or its attachment point/use is the primary product feature; use DogSeatbelt when the dog being connected to or visibly secured by the restraint is the main beat.
scene_definitions.NonSlipDemo: Observable demonstration that the product resists sliding or provides grip; do not infer non-slip performance from a static surface alone.
scene_definitions.WaterproofDemo: Observable liquid/water resistance proof such as pouring, beading, wiping, or another visible water test; do not infer waterproofness from material appearance alone.
scene_definitions.ScratchResistanceDemo: Observable scratch-resistance demonstration, such as dog nails, keys, or another deliberate object scratching/raking the cover to show resistance to visible damage.
scene_definitions.AirVentAccess: Shows that the mesh-window area allows vehicle air vents to remain unobstructed so airflow can reach the backseat; use MeshWindow when airflow/vent access is not the primary point.
scene_definitions.ProductLogo: PawpyStuff/CozyRider product logo or branded mark on the product is the primary visual subject.
scene_definitions.CarryCase: Carry-case footage including showing, packing, storing, opening, or unpacking the case; use IncludedParts when contents are laid out as the primary subject.
scene_definitions.ReinforcedSeams: Reinforced stitching/seams are clearly visible or explicitly demonstrated as the primary product detail.
scene_definitions.IncludedParts: Included components/accessories are laid out or presented as the primary subject.
scene_definitions.ExtendsBackseat: The hard-bottom platform visibly bridges the seat/footwell gap to extend usable backseat space.
scene_definitions.FoldsForPassenger: The passenger-side panel is folded or the finished one-passenger configuration is shown as the primary benefit.
scene_definitions.CarryGroceries: CozyRider is used as a stable backseat platform for carrying/loading/transporting groceries.
scene_definitions.SetupFullProduct: A coherent start-to-finish CozyRider setup sequence containing multiple related setup steps.
scene_definitions.SetupUnfoldCover: The primary action is unfolding/opening the folded cover.
scene_definitions.SetupHeadrestStraps: The primary action is attaching, tightening, or adjusting the headrest straps.
scene_definitions.SetupHardBottomPanels: Hard-bottom panel access/setup is the primary action, including inserting or removing the boards, opening or closing the underside board-compartment zipper, or opening or closing the underside Velcro board compartment for board access.
scene_definitions.ShakeOutCover: The creator deliberately shakes/flaps the full cover open or outward to spread, display, or prepare it. Use SetupUnfoldCover when the primary action is unfolding a folded cover.
scene_definitions.RemoveCoverFromVehicle: The primary action is removing the CozyRider cover from the vehicle, regardless of whether the next step is washing, storage, or another purpose.
scene_definitions.HoseDownCover: The cover is actively hosed or rinsed with water as the primary cleaning demonstration.
scene_definitions.Testimonial: Creator-to-camera spoken experience, opinion, recommendation, or results about CozyRider is the dominant creative beat. Use ProductUse_Testimonial when a dog is actively using/occupying CozyRider during the testimonial; otherwise use ProductShot_Testimonial. If a specific dog action is clearly the primary beat, use that ProductUse Scene instead.
scene_definitions.CleanWipeFabric: Active wiping/cleaning/maintenance of the cover fabric is the primary action.
scene_definitions.DogRiding: Dog is actively traveling/riding on the CozyRider as the primary beat when filmed from inside the vehicle; this includes the dog looking out the window from an interior camera position.
scene_definitions.DogRidingExteriorView: Dog is riding in the vehicle while the camera films from outside the vehicle looking in through or beside the window; the exterior vehicle perspective is a defining part of the shot.
scene_definitions.DogSitting: Dog is already sitting on the CozyRider and the sitting posture is the primary beat.
scene_definitions.DogSitsDown: The primary action is the dog transitioning from standing/upright into a seated position on the CozyRider.
scene_definitions.DogStanding: Dog is already inside the vehicle and standing, stepping, or walking on the CozyRider platform as the primary beat.
scene_definitions.DogLying: Dog is already lying/resting on the CozyRider and the lying posture is the primary beat.
scene_definitions.DogLiesDown: The primary action is the dog lowering/transferring from an upright or seated position into a lying position on the CozyRider.
scene_definitions.DogEntering: Dog transitions from outside the vehicle/backseat into the CozyRider, including jumping, climbing, stepping in, or owner-assisted/lifted entry.
scene_definitions.DogExiting: Dog exits the vehicle/backseat to the outside.
scene_definitions.DogTurningAround: Dog visibly turns/repositions on the platform, demonstrating usable space.
scene_definitions.DogSeatbelt: Dog is being connected to the seatbelt/tether system or is already visibly secured by it while using CozyRider. Use ProductShot_SeatbeltTether when the restraint hardware itself is demonstrated without dog use.
scene_definitions.OwnerPetsDog: Owner petting the dog while the dog is using/occupying CozyRider is the primary beat.
scene_definitions.BackseatGap: The open gap/footwell between seating surfaces is the primary problem visual.
scene_definitions.DogSlips: Dog visibly loses traction or footing. Use DogFallsIntoFootwell for an actual fall into the footwell.
scene_definitions.DogFallsIntoFootwell: Dog visibly falls or drops into the footwell/gap.
scene_definitions.DogAnxious: Strong sustained anxiety behavior such as repeated pacing, whining, panting, or agitation; ambiguous emotion must be reviewed.
scene_definitions.SeatCoverSags: A low-quality/soft cover visibly sags, collapses, or fails to provide a level supported surface.
scene_definitions.FailedSeatCover: A low-quality or inadequate previous cover is criticized, tested, rejected, discarded, or broadly demonstrated as a failed solution.
scene_definitions.WeakPlasticClips: Weak/flimsy plastic hardware on a competing or failed cover is the primary visible proof; literal breakage is not required.
scene_definitions.DoorScratches: Scratched/damaged vehicle door surfaces are the primary problem visual.
scene_definitions.DirtyBackseat: Dirty, muddy, hairy, wet, or otherwise soiled backseat is the primary problem visual.
scene_definitions.CrampedBackseat: Insufficient usable backseat space for the dog is the primary problem visual.
scene_definitions.BeforeAfterFailedSeatCoverVsPlatform: A deliberate comparison shows a failed/cheap/old seat cover first and the CozyRider hard-bottom platform as the replacement/solution.

conditional_rules.dog_type: Omit when no dog is visible. Use a specific approved breed only above the calibrated high-precision gate; otherwise OtherDog. Any visible breed not in the approved DogType allow-list is OtherDog. MultiDog when multiple dogs are primary.
conditional_rules.vehicle_class: Omit when not visible or below calibrated gate. FullSizeTruck requires strong exterior/body evidence or trusted metadata.
conditional_rules.take: Use T01-T## only for same-stem nonduplicate repeated takes within one creator/product library.
conditional_rules.testimonial_category: Testimonial may be ProductShot or ProductUse. Use ProductUse_Testimonial when the testimonial is dominant while a dog is actively using/occupying CozyRider; otherwise use ProductShot_Testimonial. If a specific dog action is clearly the primary beat, use that ProductUse Scene instead.

needs_split_rule: NeedsSplit only when two or more separate segments would receive different primary Scene classifications and would be independently useful editor assets. Length, repeated examples of one Scene, or framing changes alone do not split.
long_video_rule: >10 minutes routes to NeedsReview with LongVideo; length alone does not imply NeedsSplit.

output_schema.folder_category: required category token from folder path
output_schema.category: required validated category token; equals folder_category on auto-rename
output_schema.secondary_actions: metadata array of approved Scene tokens
output_schema.review_reasons: conditional array of approved review reasons
